cases.sentence: Авель пас стада, а Каин обрабатывал ___.
cases.translation: Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the ground.
cases.explain: The transitive verb обрабатывать takes its direct object in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Каин принес в дар ___ плоды земли.
cases.translation: Cain brought the fruit of the ground as an offering to the Lord.
cases.explain: The phrase принести в дар (to bring as a gift to someone) takes the recipient in the dative.

cases.sentence: Кровь твоего ___ взывает ко мне из земли.
cases.translation: The blood of your brother cries out to me from the ground.
cases.explain: The possessive 'of your brother' requires the genitive case.

cases.translation: With the Lord's help I have gotten a man.
cases.explain: The transitive verb приобрести takes an animate direct object in the accusative (which matches the genitive form).

cases.sentence: Ламех взял себе в жены двух ___.
cases.translation: Lamech took two women as his wives.
cases.explain: The numeral двух governs the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Он стал ___ тех, кто живет в шатрах.
cases.translation: He became the father of those who live in tents.
cases.explain: The verb стать (to become) requires its predicate in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Он стал отцом тех, кто живет в ___.
cases.translation: He became the father of those who live in tents.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Бог даровал мне другое дитя вместо ___.
cases.translation: God has given me another child instead of Abel.
cases.explain: The preposition вместо (instead of) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Авель пас стада, а Каин обрабатывал землю.
reading.question: What were the occupations of Abel and Cain?
options: Abel kept flocks and Cain worked the ground
reading.correct: Abel kept flocks and Cain worked the ground
reading.explain: The text says 'Авель пас стада, а Каин обрабатывал землю' (Abel kept flocks, Cain worked the ground).

reading.ru: Авель и его дар были угодны Господу, но Каин и его дар не были угодны ему.
reading.question: Whose offering was pleasing to the Lord?
reading.explain: The text says 'Авель и его дар были угодны Господу' (Abel and his offering were pleasing to the Lord), but not Cain's.

reading.ru: Когда они были в поле, Каин накинулся на своего брата Авеля и убил его.
reading.question: What did Cain do to Abel in the field?
reading.explain: The text says Cain 'накинулся на своего брата Авеля и убил его' (attacked his brother Abel and killed him).

reading.ru: И Господь сделал Каину метку, чтобы никто, встретившись с ним, не убил его.
reading.question: Why did the Lord put a mark on Cain?
options: So that no one who met him would kill him
To mark him as a leader
reading.correct: So that no one who met him would kill him
reading.explain: The text says the mark was made 'чтобы никто... не убил его' (so that no one would kill him).

reading.ru: Каин ушел от Господа и жил в земле Нот, к востоку от Эдема.
reading.question: Where did Cain settle after leaving the Lord's presence?
options: In the land of Nod, east of Eden
reading.correct: In the land of Nod, east of Eden
reading.explain: The text says he lived 'в земле Нот, к востоку от Эдема' (in the land of Nod, east of Eden).

reading.ru: Ламех взял себе в жены двух женщин, одну звали Ада, другую Цила.
reading.question: How many wives did Lamech take?
reading.explain: The text says Lamech took 'двух женщин' (two women), Adah and Zillah.
